## Meaning

This monitor fired because extrapolating the recent trend, the resource is projected to cross its limit inside the forecast horizon. It has NOT crossed it yet — the lead time is the point of this alert.

Query:

```
max(next_3d):forecast(avg:system.disk.in_use{__SCOPE__} by {cluster,host,device}, 'linear', 1, interval='60m', history='1w', model='default') > 0.95
```

**Design note.** Replaces "disk > 90%". A volume steady at 92% for two years is not an incident; a volume at 60% growing 8%/day is. Three days of lead time is the shortest window in which a human can reliably act.

## Impact

Nothing is broken yet. A boundary will be crossed if nobody acts within the lead time this monitor provides.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-infra-compute-availability`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `auto-capacity-ticket` (fully automatic) runs when triggered.

Actions: `attach_forecast_chart`, `create_servicenow_task`, `assign_to_owner`.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `infrastructure-engineering` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `sre`.
3. Priority contract: P3 — next business day; this never pages.
